name: roundhouse
description: Machine and infrastructure administration for agent fleets: readiness, inventory, harness/plugin/skill parity, package baselines, auth artifacts, SSH transport and diagnosis, privileged install lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Fleet readiness, inventory, updates, auth, and SSH transport
interface.longDescription: Roundhouse keeps machines and infrastructure serviceable: fleet readiness and inventory, agent harness/plugin/skill parity, package baselines, credential artifacts, SSH transport with diagnosis and enrollment, narrow privileged install lanes. The sibling railyard plugin decides and routes work; Roundhouse keeps the engines ready to run it.
defaultPrompt: Check fleet readiness before dispatching work to another machine.
Inventory the fleet and report drift in runtimes, plugins, and skills.
Plan and apply pending package updates on the fleet.
